summary: Georgia State Parks still book on gastateparks.reserveamerica.com (the park page's Reserve links). Fees confirmed $36 standard / $40 premium (June 2027 and Nov 2026). Electric set 50 (every site 50/30 A) + water; sewer only at host sites. 50 public sites, 25-50 ft, all fit 23 ft, 4 pull-throughs. Dump, showers, laundry, restrooms. Booking deep link written. Note cleaned of field facts (site count, hookups, facilities, booking). Phone 706-754-7979 is the park page's 'Campground Office' line - kept. Season (year-round, manual) unchanged.
flags: PIN ~310 m off: stored 34.7445,-83.3955 is in forest north of the park road, NE of the campground. The 50 public sites' GIS points centre on 34.7421,-83.3973 (span 34.7410-34.7429, -83.3984 to -83.3966). Suggest 34.7421,-83.3973; elevation_meters needs re-fetching.

Closure (day-use, not the campground): park page 'The Terrora Day Use Area Beach area will be closed for construction. Kayaking will not be available until this project's completion and the beach will remain closed this summer.' Campsites are bookable; no status change.
